title: Simple Input 2
code:
#Simple Input Program

applicant = input("Enter the applicant's name: ")
interviewer = input("Enter the interviewer's name: ")
time = input("Enter the appointment time: ")
print(interviewer, "will interview", applicant, "at", time)

lines.explanation: This statement takes applicant's name as input from the user
This statement takes interviewer's name as input from the user
This statement takes time of the interview as input from the user

This simply prints a one-line summary of the details taken from the user in the above statements. Note the text in double quotations is string where as the text without quotations is the variable that is called (printing a variable's value)
